<div class="card-body">
'''It Could Be Worse''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">もっとひどい目にあったかも</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">フォースを失う際、Xフォース消費して、失うフォースをX減らすことができる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-90o-Video.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[It Could Be Worse (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-It-Could-Be-Worse-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">監房ブロックAA-23を脱出し、反乱軍はゴミ圧縮装置に出た。レイアは言う。「もっとひどい目にあったかも。」そう、それはこれからだった。</span>''<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' It could be worse.

'''Card text:''' When about to lose Force, use X Force to reduce the Force lost by X.

'''Lore:''' After escaping Detention Block AA-23, the Rebels came out in the trash compactor. Leia said, “It could be worse.” It was about to be.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[It Could Be Worse]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
